package tracer

import (
	"context"
	"iter"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
)

// These private types model the fields consumed by the compiler hook. The
// integration suite separately tests the complete SDK and its HTTP payloads.
type SpanContext struct{ owner *Span }
type spanCtx struct {
	context.Context
	span     *Span
	snapshot *SpanContext
}
type StartSpanConfig struct {
	Context context.Context
	Parent  *SpanContext
}
type spanMutex struct {
	sync.Mutex
	held atomic.Bool
}

func (m *spanMutex) Lock()   { m.Mutex.Lock(); m.held.Store(true) }
func (m *spanMutex) Unlock() { m.held.Store(false); m.Mutex.Unlock() }

type metadata map[string]string

func (m metadata) All() iter.Seq2[string, string] {
	return func(yield func(string, string) bool) {
		for k, v := range m {
			if !yield(k, v) {
				return
			}
		}
	}
}

type Span struct {
	mu                                spanMutex
	context                           *SpanContext
	name, service, resource, spanType string
	start, duration                   int64
	error                             int32
	spanID                            uint64
	meta                              metadata
	metrics                           map[string]float64
	finished, disabled                bool
	panicBefore, panicAfter           bool
	pprofCtx                          context.Context
}

func newSpanContext(s *Span, parent *SpanContext) *SpanContext { return &SpanContext{owner: s} }
func (s *Span) Context() *SpanContext                          { return s.context }
func (c *SpanContext) TraceIDBytes() [16]byte                  { return [16]byte{1} }
func (c *SpanContext) finish(s *Span)                          { s.finished = true }

func spanStart(operationName string, opts StartSpanConfig) *Span {
	var (
		context      *SpanContext = opts.Parent
		pprofContext              = opts.Context
	)
	if context != nil && pprofContext == nil {
		pprofContext = context.owner.pprofCtx
	}
	span := &Span{name: operationName, resource: "initial", meta: metadata{}, metrics: map[string]float64{}, pprofCtx: pprofContext}
	span.context = newSpanContext(span, context)
	return span
}

func (s *Span) finish(finishTime int64) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.finished || s.disabled {
		return
	}
	s.duration = finishTime - s.start
	if s.panicBefore {
		panic("before bookkeeping")
	}
	s.context.finish(s)
	if s.panicAfter {
		panic("after bookkeeping")
	}
	// Finish bookkeeping may be followed by additional SDK field updates.
	s.resource = "final"
	s.meta["tail"] = "final"
	s.metrics["tail"] = 42
}

func ContextWithSpan(ctx context.Context, s *Span) context.Context {
	var snapshot *SpanContext
	if s != nil {
		snapshot = s.Context()
	}
	newCtx := &spanCtx{Context: ctx, span: s, snapshot: snapshot}
	return newCtx
}
